snippet.title: Over Human - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5237810/Over_Human/

Over Human is a first-person sci-fi adventure set in an isolated snowy world filled with deadly drones. Explore a mysterious frozen world, evade them as they become increasingly dangerous, and break their control over the environment by disrupting transmission terminals.

Can you uncover the world's secrets and reclaim humanity's future?

Developer: Francesco Morganti
Adding Over Human to your wishlist is free and helps support the project!
